candidates.title: Odisha Bans Fishing, Tourist Entry in 6 Districts Ahead of Cyclone Arnab
candidates.excerpt: State mobilises rescue teams, orders precautionary evacuations and shuts schools and colleges in six vulnerable districts as cyclone approaches Andhra Pradesh.

candidates.title: Migrant woman, two girls meet watery grave in Mancherial
candidates.excerpt: A 24-year-old migrant woman and two girls drowned in a pond at Kashimpalli village in Jaipur mandal of Mancherial district on Sunday while allegedly washing clothes. Police retrieved the bodies and registered a case.

candidates.title: Depression over Bay of Bengal set to become ‘very severe cyclonic storm’, cross A.P. coast by October 28
candidates.excerpt: IMD says the cyclone is likely to cross the Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coasts on Wednesday morning, with winds of 115 kmph to 125 kmph, gusting to 140 kmph; set to have worse impact than last year’s Montha cyclone

candidates.excerpt: From bloodied sheep outside fashion stores to animal-themed street theatre, animal-rights groups are turning protest into theatrical performance to make cruelty impossible to ignore

candidates.title: IMD forecasts intense rain in Telangana from October 27
candidates.excerpt: The IMD has warned of extremely heavy rainfall in parts of Telangana on October 28 as a weather system develops over the Bay of Bengal. Mulugu, Bhadradri Kothagudem and Khammam are under a red alert for intense rainfall

candidates.title: India’s green hydrogen ambition is going global; 14 deals in just the first four months of 2026, says Amitabh Kant
candidates.excerpt: India signed 14 binding clean hydrogen supply contracts in the first four months of 2026, covering 311,520 metric tonnes of annual supply, with 62% destined for export markets, former NITI Aayog CEO Amitabh Kant said. The contracts signal India's growing ambitions in the global clean energy trade.
